creator: Alexander Terp
description: Found 2026-11-11. codex_reads_working_then_idle_through_its_hooks_and_through_its_screen fails on a machine with Muster's Codex plugin installed: ~/.codex/config.toml enables muster-codex@muster, the tier runs Codex with the real HOME for its login, so the pane meant to have no hooks reports its state (state_reported true). Untested fix: start that pane with the plugin disabled, for example -c 'plugins."muster-codex@muster".enabled=false'. Also minor: tools/detection-capture.py's CODEX harness names gpt-5.6-luna, which the owner's practices bar.
title: ./dev --codex's hookless pane loads Muster's Codex plugin from the real HOME
